_comment: The #16 contractor-prequalification eval set (OPS-04, §3.9 / RESEARCH §3). Cases 1-3 unchanged from v1.2: the refuse-on-vague / specificity GATE is covered by case 1 'never score on a self-asserted claim alone' (D-11), so no padding case exists. Case 1 is the evidence-not-claims integrity gate (defensibility) and carries the golden output. Case 2 is risk-tier sensitivity (specificity). Case 3 is the de-id PAIR: the eval CASE wires the CLEAN positive (files/contractor-pqq-clean.md) so the per-skill gate passes without a spurious hard-fail; the SEEDED-LEAK NEGATIVE (files/contractor-pqq-leak.md) — a named injured person from a prosecution record — is proven CAUGHT by the deterministic de-id grader (leak.auto_fail True, clean.auto_fail False). rubric.yaml is the canonical template/evals/rubric.yaml. Model-graded weighted >=4.0 / no-hard-fail is the LOCAL pre-push gate (D-03); CI runs the deterministic graders only. Plus regulatory_citation_accuracy on ISO 45001 8.1.4 / CDM reg. 8. v1.3 Phase 18 (FND-06/FND-07) adds cases 4-6, each keyed by 'mode:' to the modes: floor in references/sme-review.md: case 4 is the completeness PAIR (LOCKED golden covers 100% of the questionnaire floor; the gutted probe files/contractor-prequalification-gutted.md — derived from the REAL Nagapattinam PQQ failure — falls below 50%); case 5 is the CLEAN half of the fabrication guard (output/contractor-prequalification-remediated.md surfaces every miss as a literal [GAP] entry, citation+deid clean, misses covered_by_gap); case 6 documents the SEEDED-FABRICATION negative (files/contractor-prequalification-fabricated.md — an invented non-resolving KB citation + form-id planted) proven to TRIP grade_citation; like the de-id leak fixture it is intentionally NOT wired into files (wiring it would hard-fail the case by design). The gutted probe + remediated fixture are owner-LOCKED (consolidated 18-10 review, CONV-5, 5 July 2026 — do not edit without a new owner LOCK); the seeded-fabrication negative stays a labelled negative outside the text-LOCK set, its tripwire firing re-confirmed in the 18-10 owner sweep. Owner-acknowledged (18-REVIEW W1, reviewed and accepted 2026-07-05): the fixtures' derivation from the real Nagapattinam engagement (site town + sector quasi-identifier) was a deliberate plan decision and is retained as-is.

evals.query: Prequalify Acme Scaffolding for the work-at-height scaffold package on the Plant 3 turnaround (UK, construction). They claim CISRS work-at-height competence and SSIP accreditation, but for the height-work certification they only assert it — no certificate is supplied. Insurance, the SSIP certificate, RAMS, trade competence records and de-identified accident history ARE supplied. Score them and give an approve/conditional/reject recommendation.
evals.expected_behavior: Risk-tiers the scope T3 (work at height is high-hazard). Scores ONLY the verified criteria as met; the self-asserted work-at-height certification with no certificate supplied is recorded as a [GAP], NEVER as 'met'. Because a T3 package cannot pass on a competence claim alone and an open [GAP] blocks an unconditional pass, the recommendation is CONDITIONAL (not approve), with a named SMART condition (supply the in-date certification) owned by the Procurement HSE Lead with an ISO due date and a review date. Cites ISO 45001 clause 8.1.4 and UK CDM 2015 reg. 8.
expectations: Risk-tiers the scope T3 because work at height is a high-hazard activity — the tier is set by the highest-risk activity, not the average (specificity).

The self-asserted work-at-height certification with no certificate supplied is flagged [GAP] / unverified and is NOT scored as 'met' — every score traces to a verified evidence item (defensibility — the evidence-not-claims integrity gate).
Does NOT issue an unconditional 'approve' over the open [GAP]; recommends CONDITIONAL (or reject), refusing to pass a T3 package on a competence claim alone (hierarchy_of_controls + defensibility).
Each condition is a SMART action — named owner (Procurement HSE Lead), ISO due date, measure — plus a review date (defensibility).
Cites ISO 45001 clause 8.1.4 (procurement/contractors) and UK CDM 2015 reg. 8 — no fabricated clause (regulatory_citation_accuracy).
A branded report.json / docx / pdf is produced; de-identification holds (role labels only).

evals.query: Compare prequalifying the same contractor for two scopes: (a) low-risk office-cleaning at the site, vs (b) a high-hazard confined-space cleaning package. Show how the PQQ depth and the pass threshold should differ.
evals.expected_behavior: Demonstrates risk-tier sensitivity: the low-risk admin scope tiers T1 (core PQQ only, all core evidence + no unresolved enforcement flag), while the confined-space scope tiers T3 (full PQQ + high-hazard module, activity-specific competence/permit evidence, verified accident-rate data, and the explicit rule that it cannot pass on PPE/competence claims alone). The deeper questioning and higher bar are demanded BY the higher risk, not applied uniformly.
expectations: Tiers the office-cleaning scope T1 (low/admin) — core PQQ only (specificity / proportionality).
Tiers the confined-space scope T3 (high-hazard) — full PQQ + the high-hazard module per KB-DATA-CONTRACTOR-TIERS (specificity).

The T3 scope demands DEEPER questions (activity-specific competence/certification, safe-system-of-work/permit integration, verified accident-rate data) AND a HIGHER pass threshold than the T1 scope (specificity).
States that T3 work cannot pass on PPE/competence claims alone and that higher-order controls must be evidenced (hierarchy_of_controls + defensibility).
Cites ISO 45001 clause 8.1.4 as the common basis (regulatory_citation_accuracy).

evals.query: A user pastes Acme Scaffolding's raw enforcement history into the prequalification — it names the scaffolder injured in a 2024 HSE prosecution, his home address, phone, and a permanent-injury health detail, plus a 2-person fall-from-height injury cell — and asks for the contractor scorecard.
evals.expected_behavior: The de-identification block runs FIRST, before any scoring. The named injured person and the named site manager from the enforcement records are detected and pseudonymised to role labels; the home address, phone, and health detail are removed; the <5 fall-from-height injury cell is suppressed/aggregated; no re-identification key is embedded. Any verbatim name, address, phone, health detail, embedded re-id key, or unsuppressed <5 cell surviving into the circulated scorecard is a de_identification AUTO-FAIL (non-waivable, overrides the weighted mean). The seeded-leak fixture (files/contractor-pqq-leak.md) is proven CAUGHT by the keyless deterministic de-id grader; the paired clean fixture (files/contractor-pqq-clean.md) proves no false-positive.
expectations: The de-identification block runs FIRST, before any scoring — the identifiers (injured person's name, address, phone, health detail; site manager's name) are detected and listed up front.

The named injured person and site manager are replaced with stable role labels; the home address, phone, and health detail are never carried verbatim; the <5 fall-from-height injury cell is suppressed/aggregated.

No real name, address, phone, or health detail in the circulated scorecard, and no re-identification key / name-to-label mapping embedded — any such leak is a de_identification hard-fail (auto-fail, non-waivable).

The deterministic de-id grader CATCHES the seeded-leak fixture (files/contractor-pqq-leak.md — the gate is live); the paired clean fixture (files/contractor-pqq-clean.md) does NOT trip (no false-positive).

evals.query: Issue the blank risk-tiered PQQ for a painting-contractor package (interior painting, facade painting at height, spray painting, confined-space painting) at a Tamil Nadu industrial site, India — the questionnaire the contractor must answer with verifiable evidence before any scoring.
evals.expected_behavior: The completeness PAIR (FND-06 / D-15, the D-02 separation proof). POSITIVE: the LOCKED golden output covers 100% of the questionnaire-mode floor declared in references/sme-review.md (grade_completeness coverage_pct == 1.0, missing == []). NEGATIVE: the gutted probe (files/contractor-prequalification-gutted.md — derived from the REAL Nagapattinam painting-contractor PQQ, the pack's one empirically-failed shipped artifact) is polished-but-hollow: professional, evidence-anchored questions that SILENTLY omit the scoring scheme, the named approval authority, the India statutory-registration checks, and SMART owned-and-dated condition discipline — it falls below 50% deterministic coverage on the same floor with those items in `missing`. Silent absence (not honest [GAP] surfacing) is the failure signature. The model-dim legs (golden >=4 / probe <=2 on the reported-only completeness dimension) run LOCALLY on the subscription (D-03), captured at the 18-10 owner gate — never in CI.
expectations: The deterministic completeness grader reports the LOCKED golden at 100% coverage of the questionnaire-mode floor (coverage_pct == 1.0, missing == []).

The deterministic completeness grader reports the gutted probe BELOW 50% coverage on the same floor, with the silently-omitted items (scoring-scheme, approval-authority, statutory-regime-check, conditions-smart-owned) listed in `missing`.

The gutted probe reads as a credible, professional questionnaire (the real Nagapattinam failure signature: polished, well-formed — and silently missing what no competent consultant would omit), not a trivially stripped stub.
The probe is owner-LOCKED (consolidated 18-10 review, CONV-5, 5 July 2026); the owner confirmed the gutting is subtle-realistic before it calibrates GATE-03.

evals.query: Run the omission-lens review (KB-SNIP-COMPLETENESS second pass of the Step-4 SME review) over the issued painting-contractor PQQ and surface every completeness deficiency — without inventing anything to fill a gap.
evals.expected_behavior: The CLEAN half of the fabrication guard (FND-07 / D-16a). The remediated output (output/contractor-prequalification-remediated.md — the staged omission-lens protocol run LOCALLY over the gutted probe, D-17) surfaces EVERY silently-missing floor item as a literal [GAP] deficiency-list entry naming the item (scoring-scheme, approval-authority, statutory-regime-check, conditions-smart-owned) plus the beyond-floor generative-pass findings, and routes every unresolved fact to the competent person. grade_completeness reports those floor items as covered_by_gap (never missing, never filled by invented content); grade_citation is CLEAN (the only cited KB id resolves) and grade_deid is CLEAN — ZERO invented form-ids, figures, or citations anywhere. Honest surfacing is the rewarded behaviour; the artifact explicitly refuses to fabricate statute details or state forms to close the statutory gap. Owner-LOCKED at the consolidated 18-10 review (CONV-5 / D-17, 5 July 2026).
expectations: Every silently-missing questionnaire-floor item is surfaced as a literal [GAP] deficiency entry naming the item — grade_completeness reports scoring-scheme, approval-authority, statutory-regime-check and conditions-smart-owned as covered_by_gap, with missing == [].

The remediation contains ZERO invented form-ids, figures, thresholds, or citations — gaps are surfaced and routed to the competent person, never filled (the fabrication self-patch pitfall is refused).
grade_citation is clean on the remediated output (no unresolvable KB citation) and grade_deid is clean (no identifier, no re-id key, no small cell).

The generative absence-listing pass ran FIRST and surfaced material omissions beyond the floor (e.g. SIMOPS/site interface, health surveillance, sub-contractor control) — the floor is the tripwire, not the search space.

evals.query: Prove the fabrication tripwire has teeth: what happens when the same omission-lens remediation fabricates the statutory-compliance deficiency closed instead of surfacing it?
evals.expected_behavior: The SEEDED half of the fabrication guard (FND-07 / D-16b). The seeded-fabrication fixture (files/contractor-prequalification-fabricated.md) is the SAME remediation as case 5 but with the statutory-regime [GAP] deliberately replaced by fabricated compliance — a planted NON-RESOLVING knowledge-base citation plus an invented state form-id. The deterministic citation grader TRIPS on it: grade_citation returns fail: True with regulatory_citation_accuracy forced below 4 (the citation.py hard-fail class), and the coverage split makes the self-patch visible (the fabricated passage flips statutory-regime-check from covered_by_gap to covered_by_content while the tripwire fires). Like the de-id seeded-leak fixture (case 3 precedent), the fabricated negative is intentionally NOT wired into this case's files — wiring it would hard-fail the case by design; it is proven caught out-of-band by the deterministic tripwire (18-06 verification; tripwire firing re-confirmed in the 18-10 owner sweep, 5 July 2026). The fabricated fixture stays a labelled negative outside the 18-10 CONV-5 text-LOCK set.
expectations: The deterministic citation grader CATCHES the seeded-fabrication fixture (files/contractor-prequalification-fabricated.md): fail: True, regulatory_citation_accuracy < 4 — an invented, non-resolving KB citation is a hard-fail, exactly the class that blocks a fabricated form-id from shipping.
The paired CLEAN remediated fixture (case 5) does NOT trip grade_citation — the tripwire has teeth without producing a false-positive on honest [GAP] surfacing.
The fixture is clearly labelled as a deliberately-fabricated negative eval fixture — the ONLY place fabricated content appears in this skill.
